content: Hi! How can I help you with the school event photos today?
Hi! I'd like to share the pictures from yesterday's assembly with other parents, but I want to make sure privacy is handled right.
Absolutely, that's thoughtful of you. I've created a private album here: <assembly_album_link>. You can invite just the parents you choose, and everyone gets view-only access.
Perfect. I'd also like to add captions and alt text for accessibility, how do I do that?
Great idea! In the album, click on any photo, then select 'Edit captions.' You can add simple descriptions or fun moments, this helps everyone enjoy the memories.
Some parents are asking if they can download the originals for printing. Is that safe?
Yes, since it's a private, view-only album, only invited parents can download. There's a 'Download all' option if they'd like the originals for keepsakes or prints.
Thank you! Should I remind parents to avoid sharing the photos on social media?
That's a good step. You can add a note in the album description, gently asking everyone to respect privacy and not post images without consent from other families.
I will do that. One last thing: a few parents want to add their own photos. What's the best way?

You can give upload access to trusted parents, or invite them to send their photos to you directly, and you can add them. For tidy albums, grouping photos by activity or class helps everyone browse easily.
Thanks for all the help. I'm about to share the album link now!

You're very welcome. Once shared, encourage parents to click the album, browse the highlights, and download their favorites. Let me know if you need tips on captions or organizing. Enjoy reliving those joyful moments together!
